blog_summary: Adrian Colyer highlights Airbnb's production-deployed dynamic pricing system, which has been iteratively improved over more than a year to provide hosts with price suggestions that significantly boost bookings and booking values. The system addresses the complex challenge of setting optimal prices for unique listings, accounting for factors like listing attributes, temporal demand variations, seasonality, and lead time. The paper focuses on the pricing strategy model, which uses a three-component pipeline: a booking probability model (Gradient Boosting Machines), a pricing strategy model, and personalization logic. The key insight is the use of novel evaluation metrics—price decrease recall (PDR) and booking regret (BR)—to train the pricing model in the absence of ground truth optimal prices, along with a carefully designed loss function to balance these metrics.
paper_title: Customized Regression Model for Airbnb Dynamic Pricing
